attempts.summary: Configured node1 (CentOS Stream 10, BLS/grubby bootloader) to boot with audit=1 persistently via `grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=\"audit=1\"`, which updated both the BLS entry and /etc/kernel/cmdline. Rebooted node1 to verify persistence, confirmed a changed boot_id proving an actual restart, and confirmed /proc/cmdline and kernel dmesg both show audit=1 active post-reboot.
